Veteran CFO Bill Zerella Aims to Fast-Track Growth at Stord

Zerella, who’s shepherded three other startups through their IPOs, is looking to build scale organically and through acquisitions at supply-chain-focused Stord

By

Bill Zerella, a veteran finance chief of late-stage startups, is taking on a new challenge as CFO of the logistics firm Stord, aiming to accelerate the firm’s expansion and improve its operating margins.

Zerella, who joined Stord in August, is focused on adding scale to the company’s network of more than 100 warehouses and fulfillment centers, including through acquisitions. Stord helps merchants compete with bigger retailers such as Amazon.com by providing an end-to-end e-commerce platform for companies that includes warehouse and fulfillment centers. The company, established 11 years ago, has grown rapidly in recent years, lifted in part by the acceleration of e-commerce during the pandemic.
